notes: Despite 'hydrogen storage' in the title, the paper's hydrogen work is electrochemistry in an electrolyte. Main, p. 3, Section 2.2: '5 mg of GO + Tb composite material was dispersed in 10 ml of an aqueous electrolyte (3 M H2SO4) for 2 h.' and 'LSV (Linear Sweep Voltammetry) was studied at an applied voltage of 400 mV at different scan rates to observe the maximum hydrogen evolution.' Main, p. 5, Section 3.3: 'The linear sweep voltammetry curves (Fig. 3d) indicate that hydrogen evolution occurs from 400 mV to 200 mV'. Fig. 3 (p. 4) shows only CV, Tafel, LSV and impedance plots (current vs potential). The DFT work (Section 2.3, Section 3.8, ESI) models Tb-decorated GO without hydrogen, and the paper also reports experiments, so theoretical_only does not apply. No surface area is reported either. Not a review; not flagged or stated as retracted; no statement of previously published H2 data.
